body.message:
I would like to confirm that, although the check-in form reflects a monthly arrangement, our agreement is for a total stay of three months under the same agreed monthly rate of AED 5500 AED without any changes or increases during this period.

Kindly confirm that the same rate will be maintained for all three months, and that the separate contract for the remaining two months will reflect these agreed terms.

Also noted regarding the number of guests — thank you for confirming.

I look forward to your confirmation.
